tagline: Developing innovative specialty chemicals for cleaner fuels and sustainable industrial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Fuel Specialties segment is the primary driver of profitable growth, with margin expansion and resilience through cycles, driven by innovation in clean fuels and non-fuel applications.

kpis.name: Fuel Specialties Operating Income Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in operating profit from the Fuel Additives segment.
kpis.description: The Fuel Specialties segment saw its operating income increase by 12% in 2025 (144.8M$ vs 129.6M$ in 2024), driven by a better sales mix and pricing discipline.
kpis.signal: Strong growth despite stable revenues, indicating excellent cost and mix management.

kpis.name: Performance Chemicals Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth in the Performance Chemicals segment.
kpis.description: The segment recorded a 4% revenue increase in 2025 (681.4M$ vs 653.7M$ in 2024), driven by new products in personal and industrial care.
kpis.signal: Organic growth in a strategic segment despite margin pressures.

kpis.name: Oilfield Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Decline in revenue from the Oilfield Services segment.
kpis.description: The segment experienced a 19% revenue decline in 2025 (395.1M$ vs 490.6M$ in 2024), impacted by unfavorable conditions in several key markets.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to lack of recovery in Latin America and weaker activity in the Middle East.

kpis.name: Consolidated Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Consolidated operating margin was 7.3% in 2025 (129.5M$ operating income / 1.778B$ revenue) compared to 9.6% in 2024, impacted by non-recurring charges of 62.0M$.
kpis.signal: Margin contraction due to impairments and restructuring charges, adjusted operating margin remained stable.

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin declined to 27.7% in 2025 (492.4M$ gross profit / 1.778B$ revenue) from 29.4% in 2024 (542.9M$ / 1.8454B$).
kpis.signal: 170 basis point gross margin contraction, reflecting cost challenges in Performance Chemicals and Oilfield Services, partially offset by Fuel Specialties.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow after Capex
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities after deducting capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow after capex reached 63.9 million dollars in 2025, reflecting strong cash generation.
kpis.signal: Robust cash flow demonstrating internal funding capacity despite operational challenges.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Financial debt minus cash and cash equivalents.
kpis.description: Innospec had no financial debt as of December 31, 2025, with 292.5 million dollars in cash and cash equivalents, resulting in a zero net debt position.
kpis.signal: Very strong balance sheet with no net debt, providing significant financial flexibility for M&A, organic growth, and shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Dividend Growth per Share
kpis.explanation: Annual increase in dividend in dollars per ordinary share.
kpis.description: Dividend per share increased by 10% in 2025, raised to 1.71 dollars per share (vs 1.55$ in 2024), reflecting management's confidence in cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to shareholder remuneration and distribution of excess cash.

kpis.name: Share Buybacks
kpis.explanation: Total amount spent to repurchase and cancel outstanding ordinary shares.
kpis.description: The company repurchased 264,000 shares for a total amount of 23.9 million dollars in 2025, demonstrating balanced capital allocation.
kpis.signal: Disciplined use of excess cash to create shareholder value through share count reduction.

risks.title: Competition and Market Conditions
risks.summary: Increased competition could affect sales and pricing, particularly in the Performance Chemicals and Fuel Specialties segments.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to increased competition from larger, better-financed firms, which could impact its operating results. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Macroeconomic Risks
risks.summary: Geopolitical and macroeconomic risks have a significant impact, particularly in Latin America and the Middle East, affecting the Oilfield Services segment.
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events and global economic conditions, including instability in certain markets, could disrupt operations and affect oil and gas drilling rates. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cybersecurity risks could significantly impact operations, business continuity, and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including cyberattacks and security breaches, which could affect operations and results. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions and raw material cost volatility represent a significant operational risk across all segments.
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions and fluctuations in raw material costs could affect operating margins and production continuity. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Decline in AvGas and Aviation Fuels Market
risks.summary: The transition to alternative fuels and technological innovations in aviation present opportunities but also risks of portfolio devaluation.
risks.score_rationale: The potential structural decline in the aviation gasoline (AvGas) market could affect volumes and revenues in the Fuel Specialties segment. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Risks
risks.summary: Increasing environmental regulations, including emissions standards and remediation obligations (notably at Ellesmere Port, 65.1M$ in provisions), represent a financial risk.
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes related to emissions, fuel quality, and chemical use could require significant investments or affect demand. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Loss of Key Personnel and Human Resources
risks.summary: Dependence on technical expertise and key talent in product innovation poses a risk to management continuity.
risks.score_rationale: The loss of key personnel and difficulties in attracting and retaining talent could affect innovation capacity and operational continuity. (Item 1A)
